entries.subject: SDSS DR9 color HiPS
entries.finding: A 3000 x 3000 px hips2fits cutout of CDS/P/SDSS9/color, 10.86 arcmin wide, 1.6 times NGC 4649's D25 diameter. Its sky level is (17, 13, 9) of 255.
